## Workflow or correction

Link the category and describe the change, what you checked, and the specific work by each author. Include GitHub profiles and identify coauthors who consent to public credit.

## Sources, rights and agreement

Identify outside material, examples and components with their sources, licenses and required attribution. Explain material AI assistance and provenance, employer authorization where applicable, and each rights holder. Do not include private, personal or client data or private email addresses. The submitter and each additional rights holder must confirm from their own account, or through a verified authorized representative, for this PR, its reviewed commit and the agreement’s permanent link. Add the comment links for manual maintainer verification. The automated check reads only the two boxes below.

For each newly credited coauthor, add a line using the format `Credit confirmation @handle https://github.com/aunysillyme-dev/stack/pull/NUMBER#issuecomment-ID`. Link their comment on this PR. A maintainer verifies who wrote it and what they approved.
